DHAKA, July 20 (Reuter) - A pledge by the new chief of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Mohammad Abu Sayeed, to boost the capital market may propel a recovery by the Dhaka stocks when the market reopens after the weekend on Sunday, brokers said. "He appears serious. His meeting with brokers last week will greatly help to bring back the confidence of players," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed. Golam Sarwar of Mahbub Morshed & Co said the recent bear run had left prices attractive which may encourage buyers.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index lost 5.01 points at 1,002.26 on a turnover of 45.9 million taka. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
